title: I pushed pure HTML and Three.js to the limit to create this hack-and-slash boss fight!
author: AnandArunim
selftext:
Title:KALIYUGAM

\[GameplayTrailer\](https://youtu.be/6UIJBnYJv84?si=8TTymSLtQoTG5RP6)

Download Link: \[https://arunimz.itch.io/kaliyugam\](https://arunimz.itch.io/kaliyugam)

Description:Kaliyugam is a 3D retro-inspired boss-rush action game set in a post-apocalyptic 2026. Earth has been reduced to ash and shattered concrete by Android 47, a mechanical executioner. You play as Arun, the last surviving warrior, seeking vengeance against the forces responsible for humanity's fall.

Your journey takes you across three distinct realms and multi-phase boss fights:

Level 1 (Earth): Battle Android 47 and its giant colossus form in a ruined city.

Level 2 (Hell): Descend into the underworld to fight Satan and his flying legion with dual blades.

Level 3 (Heavens): Ascend to Heaven’s Zenith to confront the dark manifestation of your own soul across three escalating phases (Dark Swordsman, Fallen Angel, and Transcendent God).

Gameplay features fast-paced 3D combat, aerial dash mechanics, ki-charging, and an evolving arsenal including the Single Sword, Dual Swords, and Satan’s Trident. You can also unleash special energy abilities such as the Bang Beam, Flowing Fist Beam, Perfect Illusion, and God's Eye. I would love to hear your feedback on difficulty scaling, combat feel, and boss mechanics!
